jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst
jobs.description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. Dabei decken unsere Gesellschaften jeden Schritt des Recyclingkreislaufs ab: vom Handel mit Sekundärrohstoffen und PCR-/PIR-Stoffströmen über die Trennung komplexer Kunststoffgemische mit innovativen Dichtetrennverfahren und die Regranulierung in großen Mengen bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Recompounds für technische Kunststoffe. Digitale Geschäftsprozesse verbinden bei uns alle Bereiche: vom Vertrieb über die Steuerung der Stoffströme und die Produktion bis zur kaufmännischen Abwicklung. Dan zouden we zomaar eens een match kunnen zijn. Wie zoeken we? We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij IT-vragen of problemen . Zo weet je bijvoorbeeld wat het verschil is tussen een TAC en TAC 2 LAN netwerk of je kan rechten correct toewijzen in SharePoint. Je registreert en bewaakt meldingen in het systeem en zorgt voor een tijdige opvolging. Daarnaast weet precies hoe je iemand geruststelt, duidelijk communiceert en snel tot de kern van het probleem komt. Tot slot wordt je soms ook betrokken bij installatie van hardware en software migraties. Een diverse en uitdagende functie dus. Of je nu net van school komt of al wat meters hebt gemaakt in de IT: we horen graag van je. Wie zijn wij? Welkom bij Progression IT . Wij zijn een hecht en ambitieus IT-bedrijf uit Terneuzen, Zeeland. Al sinds 2005 helpen we onze klanten met slimme, veilige en toekomstgerichte IT-oplossingen. We doen dat met een enthousiast team van 25 collega’s – stuk voor stuk vakmensen met hart voor hun werk én voor elkaar. Onze focus ligt op cloud- en hybride omgevingen. We werken met moderne tools en technologieën en zijn ISO27001-gecertificeerd. Dat betekent dat veiligheid bij ons geen bijzaak is, maar standaard in alles wat we doen. En minstens zo belangrijk: naast hard werken, vinden we het ook belangrijk om lol te hebben. Een of twee keer per jaar trekken we eropuit voor een teamuitje – gewoon, omdat het gezellig is. Wat ga je doen? 🔹 Klanten telefonisch en op afstand ondersteunen (±70%) 🔹 Complexere IT

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Executive
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Dans le cadre du projet CARBURE (projet DGA Rapid mené en partenariat avec la société eXO maKina), qui vise l'explicabilité de la prise de décision dans la lutte contre la falsification d'images à partir de réseaux profonds, nous recrutons une ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement au sein de notre Département Sciences des Données. En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et les équipes de recherche partenaires, vous aurez pour mission principale de développer un outil d'accompagnement à l'analyse et à l'explicabilité de la falsification d'images. Vous concevrez une architecture reposant sur des RAGs multimodaux spécialisés (liés à l'interprétation des filtres du logiciel Tungstène) et assurerez leur synthèse dynamique. Vous mettrez également en place un démonstrateur (PoC) autonome fonctionnant hors réseau et valoriserez ces travaux par la rédaction de livrables techniques et de publications scientifiques. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it. I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself. The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
jobs.description: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits. We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform. Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers. We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable. Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker. Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery. We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output. What you'll do: Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. jobs.description: Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋 Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis ! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Java / Spring Boot & Cloud
jobs.description: Für unseren Kunden suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Software Engineer mit Schwerpunkt Java, Spring Boot und Cloud-Technologien. In dieser vielseitigen Rolle bist du für die Weiterentwicklung, Modernisierung und den Betrieb geschäftskritischer Applikationen verantwortlich. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf räumlichen Informationssystemen (RIS), der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Softwarearchitekturen sowie dem Aufbau und der langfristigen Betreuung von Business-Intelligence-Lösungen mit Power BI. Du arbeitest in einem agilen Scrum-Team innerhalb eines SAFe-Umfelds und gestaltest gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Entwicklungsteams die technologische Weiterentwicklung der Applikationslandschaft. Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung bestehender Applikationen auf Basis von Java und Spring Boot Aktive Mitgestaltung der Softwarearchitektur im Bereich räumlicher Informationssysteme (RIS) Sicherstellung des stabilen Betriebs sowie der kontinuierlichen Optimierung bestehender Anwendungen Weiterentwicklung und Betreuung von Business-Intelligence-Lösungen mit Microsoft Power BI Mitarbeit bei der Modernisierung von Anwendungen und deren Integrationen Optimierung bestehender Prozesse und Sicherstellung des langfristigen Substanzerhalts der Applikationen Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams innerhalb eines Agile Release Trains (ART) Aktive Mitarbeit in einem Scrum-Team nach SAFe -->Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2–3 Präsenztagen pro Woche in Bern Wankdorf Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java und Spring Boot Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit OpenShift, Kubernetes und Jenkins Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit .NET und Angular Fundierte Kenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken, insbesondere SQL und Oracle Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Git, PowerShell, Bash, IntelliJ und Keycloak Praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power BI, insbesondere: Dataflows und semantische Modelle Dedicated Gateways Entwicklung und Erstellung von Reports Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklun

jobs.description: Park IP, a Welo Global brand, is a global IP solutions partner built for modern intellectual property work. The company enables legal teams to protect intellectual assets with accuracy, clarity, and confidence across jurisdictions. Trusted by Am Law 200 firms and Fortune 500 corporate legal departments, Park IP combines deep IP expertise with AI-powered workflows that reduce risk, improve predictability, and deliver greater visibility and control across the IP lifecycle, from prosecution to litigation and compliance. Its Legal Studio platform strengthens portfolio management through jurisdiction-specific coordination and real-time oversight, while experienced IP professionals remain accountable for quality and judgment. Operating under ISO-aligned quality and security standards, Park IP advances a disciplined and transparent approach to managing intellectual property worldwide. parkip.com MAIN PUROPOSE OF JOB The Brazilian Portuguese Patent Language Lead is a critical position that requires a strong background in translation, localization, and copy-editing tasks with a focus on patent/legal documents. This professional is responsible for translating, copy editing or reviewing complex patent/legal materials from English into Brazilian Portuguese, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy of the deliverables to client. This role works closely with Quality, Program Squads, Talent, vendors and other stakeholders to provide precise language support for patent-related matters. This professional ensures that the expected level of translation quality is maintained, and the product delivered to the client should always meet its intended purpose, while closely monitoring that translation expenses remain within budget. The Brazilian Portuguese Patent Language Lead understands legal requirements and engages the production team in the fulfillment of these requirements, crafting client solutions based on the Welo Global Four Pillars of Customer Service, Quality, Innovation and Gl

jobs.title: Staff Writer (Satire), the Exploit
jobs.description: Summary of the Role the Exploit ( theexploit.co ) is the security and tech industry's most trusted source of news that didn't happen. It's a satirical publication from Maze , an AI-native security company, covering the breaches, vendor launches, board meetings, AI news and compliance audits that are hilarious and totally made up, even when they don't feel like it. We're hiring two satire content creators who can write a story and then turn it into a video. Each story runs as an article on the Exploit, then becomes a short social video, usually a 30- to 90-second news segment. If you can shoot and edit the video yourself, that's a big plus. If you can't, your scripts need to be good enough that we'll happily make them for you. We'll take a great writer with no camera over a great camera with nothing to say. Two formats we like: Matt Johansen's security news recaps , where one person covers one story fast with some comedy in it, and Ev Hand , who covers sports news in the article style we're after. jobs.description: 📜 Contexte Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse , nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles. Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés , vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie. Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site. 📌 Votre rôle En tant qu' Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés , vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés. Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance , ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire. jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Who We Are BeNeering was founded in 2007 by experienced SAP solution architects who had spent years working inside global corporations. We know from first-hand experience where procurement gets slowed down and how to fix it. As a German software company and certified SAP partner, we started out in consulting and became a solutions provider in 2013. Our core development team from that time is still with us today. Our main product is the BeNeering Digital Procurement Platform . It uses AI-powered guidance and automation to make indirect procurement easy. The platform connects to SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA in real time, so SAP remains the system of record while employees shop in a modern, intuitive interface that feels like a web shop. Many of our customers use it as the modern replacement for SAP SRM. BeNeering is privately owned and has no outside investors. We don’t chase short-term targets. We build long-term partnerships and develop our product together with our customers About the Job Do you design AI solutions that hold up in production, write solid Python, and enjoy being the person customers trust to deliver? At BeNeering you will architect and build AI features for procurement used by global companies, and run customer projects end to end. Why Climate Matters More Than Ever Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold. The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action. The Opportunity Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions. jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management,

Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive , you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue . This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges. You Will Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles. Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline. Notre plateforme aide les entrepreneurs à gagner du temps sur les tâches comptables et financières, et permet aux cabinets d’expertise-comptable de se concentrer davantage sur le conseil et l’accompagnement de leurs clients. Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, et souhaitant mettre son expertise métier au service de l’accompagnement de nos utilisateurs. Ta connaissance de la comptabilité et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de comprendre rapidement leurs problématiques, de leur apporter des réponses adaptées et de les aider à tirer pleinement parti de Pennylane. 🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ? Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible 🚀 Déjà plus de 900 000 TPE/PME et plus de 6 000 cabinets d'expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! 🎯 Ton rôle Tu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme. jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expe

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Recruiter Tech (m/w/d), 180° Delivery, 100 % Remote
jobs.description: Die meisten Recruiter sind Postboten. Wir nicht. Die Branche ist kaputt. Hunderte Kandidaten werden angespammt, CVs blind rausgeschickt, und dann wird gebetet. Das Ergebnis sind genervte Kunden, verbrannte Talente und Placement-Quoten zum Weinen. Bei Recruitment Circle machen wir Delivery anders: mit Daten, Psychologie und einem Auswahlverfahren, das Blender aussortiert, bevor der Kunde sie sieht. Das Ergebnis: 7 von 10 Kandidaten, die wir einreichen, landen im Interview. Der Markt liegt bei 10–20 %. Dein Job: reines Delivery. Du bekommst die Mandate. Du lieferst die Menschen. Punkt. Dein Erfolg wird an Placements gemessen, nicht an Stunden: Monat 1: Du steuerst die Prozesse eines Key-Accounts eigenständig. Monat 2: Deine erste Vermittlung ist durch. Monat 6: Du hast 60.000 € Umsatz geliefert. Monat 12: Du stehst bei 250.000 € Jahresumsatz und bist eine Bank in der Delivery. Was du mitbringst 3+ Jahre Agentur-Recruiting , idealerweise bei einem kleineren Personaldienstleister. Du weißt, was Dienstleistung heißt. Sourcing-Skills: LinkedIn Recruiter, Xing, GitHub, Stack Overflow, und Lust auf neue Tools wie Juicebox und Clay. Du findest die passiven Talente, die sonst keiner erreicht. Biss im Interview: Du bohrst nach, bis die echte Performance auf dem Tisch liegt. Augenhöhe: Du sprichst mit CTOs und Practice Leads als Experte, nicht als Bittsteller. Extreme Ownership: Bei dir fällt nichts runter. Ein schweres Profil ist für dich eine Challenge, kein Grund zu jammern. Was du bekommst Geld, das Leistung abbildet: 50–60k Fix, 5–20 % Provision ab dem ersten Euro, 100k+ OTE für alle, die liefern. 100 % Remote, deutschlandweit: Kein Pendeln, keine Präsenzpflicht. Tech-Stack, der arbeitet: Recruit CRM, Apollo, Clay, Juicebox und eigene Automatisierungs-Workflows. Wir bauen die Maschine, du bedienst die Hebel. RC-Masterclass: Du lernst, Lebensläufe zu sezieren und A-Player von Blendern zu trennen Zeitnah verfügbar? Umso besser. Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und deine Place

Das bringst du mit Idealerweise 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in Digital Marketing, E-Commerce, Social Commerce, Influencer Marketing oder Brand Management. Gutes Verständnis von TikTok, Instagram, Creator Economy und Affiliate Marketing . Erste Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Projekten, Kampagnen oder externen Agenturen. Starkes Gespür für Branding, Popkultur, Social-Media-Trends und digitale Geschäftsmodelle . Organisationstalent, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Themen parallel voranzutreiben. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. jobs.title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
jobs.description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods. Assignment The assignment will include the following tasks: A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer — Agent Platform (all genders)
jobs.description: wingmaite captures the knowledge companies never write down: who decides what, how work actually gets done, and why decisions were made. Our AI agents use that knowledge to answer questions and get work done. We're looking for a Staff engineer to own the technical quality and direction of our agent platform. You'll build features end to end, from the agent into the backend. You won't manage people. You'll work closely with our CTO as a technical sparring partner. What You'll Do Design the agents: Decide how our agents plan, use tools and handle multi-step work, and where people need to step in. Build reusable components so each new use case doesn't need its own system. Connect agents to company knowledge: Build how that knowledge reaches the agents, together with the people who decide what it should contain. Make answers reliable: Agents should be correct, cite their sources, show people only what they're allowed to see, and know when not to act. Track quality: Build evals, monitor quality and cost, and keep our model choices up to date. Ship end to end: Build features from the agent through to the backend yourself. Keep the architecture consistent: Set the patterns others build on, document decisions, keep specs current, and review designs with engineering, product and design. How We Work We build features as one team: design, product, engineering and AI together, from the first idea to production. You'll help shape a feature while it's still a problem and stay with it until it works for users. Agents depend on the knowledge behind them, so we build both as one system. We write decisions down and discuss disagreements openly. What This Role Is Not A management role, a prompt-engineering role, or an infrastructure or security role. What We're Looking For Must-Haves You've shipped multi-step, tool-using LLM agents to production (LangGraph or similar) You know when sub-agents help, how to build good evals, and why retrieval fails Fluent in Python and productive in Typ

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
